exercises.why: **войти** — войти́ (perfective): to enter, to go in(to) (by foot), to get in(to); to penetrate into; to be included in; (computing) to log in. Wiktionary: во- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вполне́ — quite, fully, entirely; вниз — downwards; вслед — after, right after, behind, following; вверх — upwards.
**вхожу** — входи́ть (imperfective): to enter, to go in(to) (by foot), to get in(to); to penetrate into; to be a part of / to be included. Wiktionary: в- + ходи́ть.

to enter, to march into (of the troops)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вновь — (bookish) again, once again; внизу́ — below, underneath; влюби́ть — to cause (someone) to fall in love, to enamor; вступи́ть — to enter, to march into (of the troops).
**ввёл** — ввести́ (perfective): to introduce; to bring in, to usher in; to input. Wiktionary: в- + вести́.

pairs: to go out, to come out, to walk out
